🚗 Morning Street

Click anywhere to start (desktop) — or press ENTER VR below on Meta Quest

You start in the driver's seat in Park · press Z for Drive, then W to go

Walk WASD/arrows · Shift run · mouse look · scroll zoom · F 1st/3rd person
Car E enter/exit (door side = seat) · 1-4 change seat
Drive (automatic) W gas · S brake · A/D steer · Space handbrake · Z Drive (auto 1-6) · X Reverse · C Neutral · V Park · , / . manual gear down/up
VR L-stick move/gas · R-stick turn/steer · L-trigger handbrake · A/B gear · X sound · Y car
Other controls R / Numpad 0 = reset car onto the road (if stuck) · VR: right-stick click = reset · VR left-stick click = +3 h · ⏵ auto = day/night cycle
